text: I'm the aunt of an 11 year old boy he's staying with me this week tonight he had a fit he's never had one before in his life he went stiff then his arms and legs were shaking and his eyes rolled up it lasted maybe a minute or two I timed it on my phone as best I could he's come round now his temperature is 37.8 I've also noticed little pin prick bleeds under the skin on his legs and his tummy like tiny red purple dots I pressed a glass on them and they stay there they don't fade his mother is abroad and I need to know right now what I'm doing do I take him in or call an ambulance or what I'm not going to sit here waiting I just want a straight answer please
